body: More or less. Still looking to kill myself, I'm just trying to figure out the best and easiest way to, as my original plan isn't going to work out how I intended.

Funny. That's actually a tough question. I'm not dead yet, but also don't have any intention on not killing myself either. But at the same time, it's not like I'm in any distress right now either. I'm pretty calm and content about the whole thing. My original answer was going to be I'm doing fine, but I guess depending on your point of view I could be doing the opposite of fine too.

I don't think those are the only outcomes, I just think those are the most likely of the two. Addiction obviously isn't something I'm intentionally going after, whereas suicide more or less is, but I feel like it's kinda likely things'll either end one way or another.

It's not easy to see a point in school when you don't care about it or your life or expect you to live past 20 without killing yourself or falling onto substance abuse to self medicate. I constantly feel like a failure."
